questions: What is a sprite?
If the sprite faces the other way, does it have to turn around?
What is a life?
If you lose a life, are you out for good?
What is a blend?
If the blend changes, do the original colors change?
What is tracking?
If the tracking is lost, will it find its way back by itself?
What is culling?
If the culling stops, does everything come back?
What is a skin?
If the skin is removed, does anything still move?
What is a material?
If the material changes, does the object become something else?
What is a texture?
If the texture is rough, will it hurt when you touch it?
What is a mask?
If the mask comes off, is the face necessarily visible?
What is an anchor?
If the anchor is lost, does everything drift away?
What is a collision?
If the collision is detected, does anything have to be damaged?
What is a checkpoint?
If you go back to a checkpoint, do you keep everything you had?
What is a seed?
If the seed is the same, will the result be the same?
What is mapping?
If the mapping is wrong, do you end up in the wrong place?
What is a script?
If the script changes, do the characters have to say different things?
